prep: On 105 releases since 2018-01-12, gold moved a median ±0.63% on the day and closed up 60% of the time.
When Core CPI m/m came in higher than the release before, gold averaged +0.21% on the day (n 26); lower: +0.68% (n 24).
Against the calendar consensus (Forex Factory via a community dataset to April 2025, the council's own captures from November 2026): above it gold averaged -0.05% (n 32), below it +0.73% (n 26).

In the first 5 minutes gold went the way of the miss against consensus (hot = down) on 37 of 48 releases; trading on from minute 5 to minute 60 gave no reliable gain (study FAIL, t 1.23 out of sample). Know the side before the print; do not chase after it.

prep: On 87 releases since 2018-01-26, gold moved a median ±0.49% on the day and closed up 57% of the time.
When GDP q/q (annualized) came in higher than the release before, gold averaged -0.04% on the day (n 16); lower: +0.14% (n 31).
Against the calendar consensus (Forex Factory via a community dataset to April 2025, the council's own captures from November 2026): above it gold averaged -0.09% (n 35), below it +0.16% (n 32).

sources: Expected: the economic-calendar consensus, from Forex Factory via a community dataset (council/consensus-history.json: Forex Factory's calendar 2018 to 7 Apr 2025 as collected by a third party, MIT as tagged by the uploader) and the consensus the council captured before the release from November 2026 (a calendar value, not a verified survey); nothing is on file between April 2025 and November 2026; for CPI 2022-24 the Cleveland Fed model (a model, not a consensus). Printed: the veteran batch's first prints 2022-24, else the calendar's printed value to April 2025, else the current FRED value of the reference month (it can include revisions). Gold / dollar: the UTC release-day close vs the close before (council daily closes); first 5 / 60 minutes from council/event-base.json (HistData, to Oct 2026).
